name: external Colosseum trial of OEH current (exploratory, not team-approved)
task: seven-class learner-specific data requirement (x1,x2,x5,x10,x20,x50,>x50); event = first budget whose full suffix has >=8/10 seeds with NR>=0.95
mdps: Colosseum (NeurIPS 2022) kernels from the authors' sampler, seed 2026; families riverswim, deepsea, frozenlake, simplegrid; stochastic; 16<=|S||A|<=256; project dynamic-range filter; 32 MDPs
logs_and_labels: project generator, 5 behavior families, pilot x10, 10 training seeds, BC/CFQI/IQL with project hyper-parameters

forecasters.b2_plus_colosseum: B2 + log diameter, value norm, log sum reciprocal gaps (privileged)

fit: matched_forecast (AFT + thresholds + depth-3 multiclass, convex OOF weights) on opened cohorts first60, second60, first120, second120, third120, fourth120, seventh120; E1 unavailable
aggregation: mean of 15 rows within MDP, then mean over MDPs
inference: paired whole-MDP bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20261014, simultaneous max-t one-sided 95% lower bounds over 4 contrasts

gate.primary: OEH vs b2_matched: both metrics mean gain>0 and lower bound>0

limitations: trained on 6 of 7 sealed cohorts (no E1)
